workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: 24.7.11. Athletic Trainers shall be provided with a duty-free meal period each day of no less than 45 minutes and no more than 60 minutes.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: No faculty meeting shall exceed one (1) hour in duration, nor extend beyond 4:30 PM, unless mutually agreed to by the Supervisor and the Building Representative.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Itinerant special subject teachers shall not be required to perform any of the following: ... General clerical work. / A secondary Teacher may be assigned to a duty in lieu of a teaching period.
